_about: The ONE ladder table every game reads (S13-A1; the kit review F3, Zafar 26 Oct): js/shared/tokens.js loads it (Tokens.ladder) for js/shared/guide.js, js/shared/bulb.js, js/shared/conversations.js, the clinic (js/clinic/kit.js Kit.BULB_MS) and Cook (js/cook/station-lib.js, js/cook/mechanics/thread.js). No game keeps a copy; build/lint/static.mjs 'bulb' reads this table alone and fails on a second one. rulesFile: the central rules (SH-155, Zafar 29 Oct: data/rules.json, read only through js/shared/rules.js), which js/shared/tokens.js loads with this table.
_help: S08-W1 (the help ladder, SH-60 SH-95 SH-96): the hint wait (how long the child must have done nothing, counted from the LAST action, before Nani helps, by level 1-4) moved to the central rules on 29 Oct (SH-155: data/rules.json levels.hintS, 7, 9, 11, 13 s); js/shared/tokens.js fills Tokens.ladder.helpMs from it, so its readers are unchanged. bulbPulseMs = stuck this long and both light bulbs pulse (15-20 s, Zafar 17 Oct).
_bulb: SH-41, D11 (Zafar): bulbMs = how long the light bulb shows English (and opens a closed card), by level 1-5 (the conversations' rungs go to 5): 8 s at every level.
